title: Maximum Floor Area for Mixed Buildings on Qualifying Residential Sites
previewText:
On qualifying residential sites, subject to the individual maximum floor area ratios for commercial, community facility and residential uses, the maximum floor area ratio for a zoning lot with buildings containing residential and non-residential uses, shall be as set forth in this Section.

Within the Greater Transit Zone, the maximum floor area ratio shall be 2.50.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Added new provision for mixed buildings in low density town centers. Former Section 35-32 (Open Space Ratio for Residential Portions of Buildings) moved, with former Section 35-34 (Floor Area Bonus for a Public Plaza or Arcade) to new Section 35-712 (Floor Area and Open Space Ratios) in alternative bulk regs for certain areas provisions.
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to expand opportunities for housing within all zoning districts, and across all 59 of the City’s Community Districts
